name: comp-363
blurb: Avatar image that opens a hovercard showing username and bio.
description: Clickable avatar image that triggers a hover card displaying profile picture, username, and short bio description.
use_when: Hover previews of profile cards or user information in lists and feeds.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.
a11y: Avatar is inside a button with aria-label; hovercard has no keyboard access.
